guidance.summary: Bounded planning guidance for a safe move.
instructions: Explain the permitted route and evidence gates without creating executable source.
Bind resourceId, target, context evidence, confirmation, movement Task, and final-position check.

procedure.summary: Declarative movement procedure for compilation into the existing Workflow DSL.
instructions: Resolve required context, enforce confirmation, invoke the declared Task binding, and hard-gate success on final position.
Prefer the shortest route that satisfies every normative constraint.
If cancellation is requested, stop issuing new work and observe the Provider until terminal or explicitly uncertain.
If movement fails, report the target, last authoritative position, Provider outcome, and safe next action.
optimizationHints: Minimize unnecessary movement without trading away safety or evidence quality.

constraints: Use only the selected resource and authorized target.
Preserve Provider authority for reservation, live resource state, and terminal execution state.
Retain the last authoritative position when cancellation or failure is uncertain.
forbiddenActions: Report completion without required final-position evidence.
requiredConfirmations: Confirm movement when existing plan or refreshed Provider risk policy requires it.

contextRequirements.description: Authoritative current position of the selected resource.
Current Provider-owned resource identity, availability, and operating state.
Permission and forbidden-area policy applicable to the movement.
